General Graduate School application deadlines
Academic programs establish their own application deadlines, which may be different than the general Graduate School deadlines described below. In such cases, program deadlines supersede the more general university deadline. Some academic programs also admit applicants for specific terms only (e.g. fall term). Applicants should check the academic program for deadline and contact information.
Semester
Domestic students
Canadian and international students
Fall (August - December)
Apply by June 1
Apply by May 1
Winter (January - April)
Apply by Oct. 1
Apply by Sept. 1
Spring/summer (May - August)
Apply by Feb. 1
Apply by Jan. 1
International applicants should allocate time for visa processing.
